legalConfidentialite.title: Privacy
legalConfidentialite.s1Body: We collect the data you provide directly during registration: first and last name, email address, date of birth, profile photo, and profile information. We also collect browsing data (IP address, browser type) to ensure the service runs properly.
legalConfidentialite.s2Body: Your data is used exclusively to: manage your account, connect you with compatible members, improve our services, and communicate with you about your activity on the platform. We never sell your data to third parties.
legalConfidentialite.s3Body: Your personal data is only shared with the technical providers needed to run the service: Vercel (website hosting), Supabase (database, authentication and photo storage), Hostinger (email delivery), Google (sign in with Google and Google Meet meetings) and DiceBear (illustrated avatar generation). These providers only process your data to deliver their service to us. No data is sold or transferred for advertising purposes.
legalConfidentialite.s4Body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Communications are encrypted via HTTPS/TLS.
legalConfidentialite.s5Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
legalConfidentialite.s5Item1: obtain a copy of your personal data
legalConfidentialite.s5Item4: receive your data in a structured format
legalConfidentialite.s5Item5: object to the processing of your data
legalConfidentialite.s5Contact: To exercise your rights, contact us at:
legalConfidentialite.s6Body: Your data is retained for the duration of your registration. If you delete your account, your data is deleted within 30 days, unless a legal retention obligation applies.
legalConfidentialite.s7Body: We only use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to function (user session, preferences). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used.
legalConfidentialite.s8Body: For any question regarding the protection of your data, you may contact our Data Protection Officer at:
legalConfidentialite.s9Intro: Garden of Alliance uses Google services in two specific cases. Here is what data we receive, why, and what we do with it.
legalConfidentialite.s9Item1: if you choose “Continue with Google”, we receive your Google name, email address and profile picture (openid, email and profile scopes). This information is used only to create and secure your account and to prefill your profile; you can edit it at any time.
legalConfidentialite.s9Item2: our administration team connects its own Google account to create Google Meet meetings for members (guided introductions, events). We only request permission to create meeting spaces (meetings.space.created): we create meeting rooms and retrieve their join links, without reading any email, calendar, contacts or files. Members do not need to connect their Google account to join a meeting.
legalConfidentialite.s9Item3: the team's Google access tokens are stored in our database hosted by Supabase, accessible only by our servers, and are only transmitted over encrypted connections (HTTPS). They are deleted as soon as Google Meet access is disconnected from the admin panel.
legalConfidentialite.s9Item4: data received from Google is not sold, not shared with third parties, not used for advertising, and not used to train artificial intelligence models.

legalCharte.intro: The Garden of Alliance platform is a sacred space, designed exclusively for born-again Christian singles wishing to build a serious romantic relationship leading to Christian marriage. Joining the platform requires unreserved acceptance of this charter, which aims to preserve holiness, safety, and mutual respect within our community.
legalCharte.axe1Title: AXIS I: Authenticity and Verification of Information
legalCharte.art1Body: The user formally agrees to provide information that is rigorously accurate, up to date, and consistent with their actual situation during registration and in the compatibility questionnaires (identity, age, marital status, professional situation, level of education, church commitment). Any lie or deliberate omission will result in immediate exclusion.
legalCharte.art2Title: Article 2 — Express authorization for verification (Profile Audit Agreement)
legalCharte.art2Body: By signing this charter, the user gives formal and express consent to the platform administrators to verify all information provided. Administrators reserve the right to require supporting documents (copy of ID, professional documents) or to contact pastoral and church references mentioned by the user to confirm their status and Christian commitment.
legalCharte.axe2Title: AXIS II: Spiritual Alignment and Site Values
legalCharte.art3Title: Article 3 — Absolute submission to the Word of God
legalCharte.art3Body: The user declares that they recognize the Bible as the supreme, infallible authority. They agree that their approach, motivations, and search criteria will be fully aligned with and submitted to the principles and instructions of Holy Scripture regarding purity, marriage, and human relationships.
legalCharte.art4Title: Article 4 — Wholesome, pure, and respectful conversations
legalCharte.art4Body: All interactions, whether public or private (built-in messaging), must be marked by dignity, temperance, and Christian kindness. Strictly prohibited: crude remarks, sexual insinuations or requests, harassment, intimidation, and blackmail. The user agrees to maintain complete purity (abstinence and sanctification) throughout exchanges.
legalCharte.art5Body: All information, photographs, or personal details concerning other members discovered on the platform must remain strictly confidential. It is formally prohibited to capture, copy, or disclose profile elements to outside third parties without the written consent of the person concerned and the administrators.

criteresEssentiels.title: The Essential Criteria for Choosing
criteresEssentiels.subtitle: Choosing a spouse is one of the most important decisions in a believer's life. Learn to build on the Rock.
criteresEssentiels.introBody: The Bible and Christian wisdom suggest several fundamental criteria for building a solid home. Here is a summary to guide your discernment.
criteresEssentiels.item1Content: The number one criterion is sharing an **active, common faith**. Watch for the "Equal Yoke" (2 Cor 6:14) and observe the fruit of the Spirit in their life.
criteresEssentiels.item1Details: Does this person seek God on their own?
criteresEssentiels.item2Content: Beauty fades, character remains. Look for **honesty, humility**, and the ability to ask for forgiveness.
criteresEssentiels.item2Details: Watch how they treat those who can offer them nothing.
criteresEssentiels.item3Content: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so? Make sure you're aligned on **calling, family, and finances**.
criteresEssentiels.item3Details: Money is one of the leading causes of conflict.
criteresEssentiels.item4Content: Your spouse should be your **best friend**. Can you talk about anything with respect? Friendship is the cement of the covenant.
criteresEssentiels.item4Details: Physical attraction is a gift, but friendship lasts.
criteresEssentiels.item5Content: God often speaks through others. What do your **mentors and spiritual parents** think of this relationship?
criteresEssentiels.item5Details: If everyone around you has reservations, that's a warning sign.
criteresEssentiels.item6Content: Christian marriage is an image of Christ and the Church. Look for someone ready for **self-giving** and loyalty.
criteresEssentiels.item6Details: Love is not just a feeling, it's a choice.
criteresEssentiels.adviceBody: Don't look for the **"perfect person"**, because they don't exist. Instead, look for someone running in the same direction as you, toward Christ, with whom you can grow and be sanctified together.
criteresEssentiels.prayerText: "Lord, help me first become the person the spouse I'm looking for deserves to find. Give me discernment to see beyond appearances, and the patience to wait for Your timing. Amen."

periodeConnaissance.title: Succeeding in the Courtship Period
periodeConnaissance.subtitle: Navigating courtship with wisdom, purity, and spiritual clarity.
periodeConnaissance.introBody: The courtship period is a pivotal stage. It is no longer simply friendship, but not yet the commitment of marriage. It is a time of discernment.
periodeConnaissance.item1Title: 1. Define the intention from the start
periodeConnaissance.item1Content: From a Christian perspective, you don't "date" someone just to pass the time. It's important to be clear that the goal is to **assess the possibility of marriage**.
periodeConnaissance.item1Details: Don't rush. Observe the person in both joy and stress.
periodeConnaissance.item2Title: 2. Prioritize the intellectual and spiritual connection
periodeConnaissance.item2Content: The classic trap is letting physical attraction take over. Address deep topics: faith, money, upbringing, past wounds.
periodeConnaissance.item2Details: Pray together, but keep enough reserve not to cloud your judgment.
periodeConnaissance.item3Content: Purity protects your heart. Discuss **physical boundaries** early on to avoid gray areas. Avoid behaving as if you were already married.
periodeConnaissance.item3Details: The goal is to honor God and the other person.
periodeConnaissance.item4Content: Isolation is a danger. Introduce the other person to your **trusted friends and family**. Stay active in your local church.
periodeConnaissance.item4Details: If your mentors have doubts, listen to them carefully.
periodeConnaissance.item5Content: It's easy to wear a mask at first. Vary the contexts: serve together, do sports, or visit families. How do you handle your first disagreement?
periodeConnaissance.item5Details: The test of reality reveals the fruit of the Spirit.
periodeConnaissance.question1: Does this person encourage me to love God more?
periodeConnaissance.question2: Can I trust them with my vulnerable points?
periodeConnaissance.question3: Do I love them for who they truly are, or for their potential?
periodeConnaissance.question4: Do we share the same vision for service and the Church?
periodeConnaissance.conclusionTitle: Knowing when to stop, if necessary
periodeConnaissance.conclusionBody: Succeeding at a courtship period doesn't necessarily mean ending in marriage. It means succeeding in **discerning God's will**. Breaking up during this period is not a failure — it's a victory of discernment. An honest breakup is better than a fragile marriage.
periodeConnaissance.goldenRuleText: "Guard your spiritual guardrail. If the relationship pulls you away from your prayer life or your responsibilities, that's a warning sign. A blessed relationship brings clarity."

prieDiscernement.title: The Prayer of Discernment
prieDiscernement.subtitle: A spiritual guide to learning to listen to God's voice before committing to the path of covenant.
prieDiscernement.introBodyPost: before making an important decision. It is not a magical ritual, but an inner disposition of listening and trusting God.
prieDiscernement.quote1: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.
prieDiscernement.when3: Moving or choosing where to live
prieDiscernement.when4: A pressing need for divine guidance
prieDiscernement.peaceBody: Discernment brings inner clarity. If a decision causes you persistent anguish despite prayer, take time to question your motivations.
prieDiscernement.step1Content: Begin with a time of **silence and reflection**. Set distractions aside. Ask the Holy Spirit to purify your motivations and open you to His will.
prieDiscernement.step2Content: Open the Bible and read passages related to your situation. God's Word is a lamp for our feet (Psalm 119:105). Let a verse speak to you.
prieDiscernement.step3Content: Speak to God simply: 'Lord, I do not want my will, but Yours. Light my path, close the doors You don't want opened.'
prieDiscernement.step4Content: God confirms His will through inner peace, circumstances, and the counsel of mature, caring Christians.
prieDiscernement.tableSubtitle: Learning to tell God's voice apart from our own desires.
prieDiscernement.finalPrayerText: "Father, I entrust this decision to You. You know the beginning and the end. I choose to trust You rather than my own calculations. May Your will be done. Amen."
prieDiscernement.finalWordBody: Christian discernment is not a formula to execute, but a **relationship to nurture**. The more you walk with God daily, the more you will recognize His voice.

chatGuide.headerVerse: "Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the body."
chatGuide.charterText: Your exchanges in the integrated messaging must reflect holiness, dignity and Christian kindness. Strictly prohibited: vulgar language, verbal impurity, carnal insinuations and any lack of respect.
chatGuide.charterTextBold: May the peace and grace of Christ guide each of your words.
chatGuide.safetyItem1: Do not share ANY sensitive personal data (exact residential address, financial information, precise workplace locations).
chatGuide.safetyItem2: STRICTLY PROHIBITED from sharing your phone numbers, email addresses or links to social networks during these initial interactions. Any premature sharing of contact details constitutes grounds for a warning.
chatGuide.acceptRules: I have read and accept these safety rules
chatGuide.rulesAccepted: ✓ Rules accepted — you may begin your exchanges
chatGuide.reward1: After 1 month of regular and edifying exchange: The administrators will arrange a private video one-on-one (secure private webinar).
chatGuide.reward2: After 2 months of interaction: For members residing in the same city, an in-person one-on-one dinner will be offered and organized by the platform as a reward for your consistency.
chatGuide.sessionsTitle: Guide to Your First 5 Discussion Sessions
chatGuide.findGuideAnytime: You can find this guide in your profile at any time.
chatGuide.session1Objective: Break the ice naturally and discover what drives your day.
chatGuide.session1Q1: How do you spend your free time after work or church commitments?
chatGuide.session1Q2: What hobbies or interests help you recharge?
chatGuide.session1Q3: Is there a passion or creative activity you'd like to develop in the future?
chatGuide.session2Objective: Understand your cultural, familial background and the origin of your values.
chatGuide.session2Q1: What city or region did you grow up in and what is your fondest childhood memory?
chatGuide.session2Q2: What is the key value your parents or guardians passed on to you that guides you today?
chatGuide.session2Q3: How do you define the place of family and brotherhood in your life?
chatGuide.session3Title: Spiritual Walk & Service in the Church
chatGuide.session3Objective: Share about your calling, commitments and daily faith life.
chatGuide.session3Q1: What department or ministry are you involved in at your local assembly?
chatGuide.session3Q2: How does your ministerial or spiritual calling align with your professional life?
chatGuide.session3Q3: What Bible passage or faith principle sustains your walk right now?
chatGuide.session3Example: "I serve in the welcome department at church, which teaches me patience. What area do you feel God is calling you to actively serve in?"
chatGuide.session4Objective: Observe your relational maturity, forgiveness and management of your social circle.
chatGuide.session4Q1: In your opinion, what are the essential qualities for building a solid and lasting friendship?
chatGuide.session4Q2: How do you handle communication when a disagreement or misunderstanding arises?
chatGuide.session4Q3: What importance do you place on spiritual counsel and accountability in your circle?
chatGuide.session4Example: "For me, sincerity and listening are the pillars of friendship. In your opinion, how should one react wisely when someone disappoints us?"
chatGuide.session5Objective: Address with vulnerability and maturity your fears and deep aspirations.
chatGuide.session5Q1: What fears or apprehensions have you learned to overcome in your journey?
chatGuide.session5Q2: What lessons do you draw from past difficulties to build a serene future?
chatGuide.session5Q3: What is your vision of healthy and transparent communication within a Christian couple?
chatGuide.session5Example: "It's not always easy to express one's fears, but prayer has greatly helped me calm my worries. What challenges have strengthened you the most spiritually?"
